AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.fieldOf_toTr.en: For every natural number $N$ and every ordered pair $p=(a,b)$ in a fixed algebraic closure $\overline{\mathbb Q}$ of $\mathbb Q$ satisfying $a^N+b^N=1$, $a\ne0$, and $b\ne0$, the intermediate field generated over $\mathbb Q$ by the algebraic number $a^N$ is contained in the intermediate field generated by both coordinates: $\mathbb Q(a^N)\subseteq\mathbb Q(a,b)$. AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.logDiff.en: For every natural number $N$ and every ordered pair $p=(a,b)\in\overline{\mathbb Q}^{\,2}$ with $a^N+b^N=1$, $a\ne0$, and $b\ne0$, let $K=\mathbb Q(a,b)$ and $d=[K:\mathbb Q]$. AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.HeightNormal.en: Let $\Omega=\overline{\mathbb Q}$ be the specified algebraic closure of $\mathbb Q$, and let $X=\Omega\setminus\{0,1\}$. For $z\in X$, put $K_z=\mathbb Q(z)$ and $n_z=[K_z:\mathbb Q]$, equivalently the degree of the minimal polynomial of $z$; this is positive. Let $h_K(t)$ denote the one-variable logarithmic height of $t$ computed in the number field $K$, and put $h(z)=h_{K_z}(z)/n_z$. For a natural number $N$, let $Y_N=\{(u,v)\in\Omega^2:u^N+v^N=1,\ u\ne0,\ v\ne0\}$. For $p=(u,v)\in Y_N$, set $L_p=\mathbb Q(u,v)$, $m_p=[L_p:\mathbb Q]>0$, and $q_N(p)=u^N\in X$. Let $H_L([u:v:1])$ be the logarithmic projective height of the three coordinates, computed in $L$, and set $\kappa_N(p)=(N-3)H_{L_p}([u:v:1])/m_p$, with subtraction in $\mathbb R$. Write $a_N=(N-3)/N$, with $N$ cast to $\mathbb R$ before subtraction and division. solution.en: Let $\Omega=\overline{\mathbb Q}$ be the specified algebraic closure of $\mathbb Q$, and let $X=\Omega\setminus\{0,1\}$. For $z\in X$, put $K_z=\mathbb Q(z)$ and $n_z=[K_z:\mathbb Q]$, equivalently the degree of the minimal polynomial of $z$; this is positive. Let $h_K(t)$ denote the one-variable logarithmic height of $t$ computed in the number field $K$, and put $h(z)=h_{K_z}(z)/n_z$. Write $D(z)=\log|\operatorname{disc}(K_z)|/n_z$ and $R(z)=n_z^{-1}\sum_{v:\,|z|_v\ne1\,\lor\,|z-1|_v\ne1}\log\operatorname N(\mathfrak p_v)$, where the sum runs over the finite places of $K_z$ satisfying the displayed condition, $|\cdot|_v$ is that place's absolute value, $\mathfrak p_v$ is its maximal ideal in the ring of integers, and $\operatorname N$ is absolute ideal norm. The sum has finite support. For each finite set $S$ of natural-number primes containing $2$ and each real $c$, let $E_{S,c}(z)$ mean that $|\log|z|_v|\le c$ and $|\log|z-1|_v|\le c$ for every finite place $v$ of $K_z$ whose residue field has characteristic in $S$, and also $|\log|z|_w|\le c$ and $|\log|z-1|_w|\le c$ for every infinite place $w$ of $K_z$. There is no sign restriction on $c$. Let $\mathcal B$ be the assertion that for every $b\in\mathbb N$, every real $\eta>0$, every such $S$, and every $c\in\mathbb R$, there exists $B\in\mathbb R$ such that every $z\in X$ with $E_{S,c}(z)$ and $n_z\le b$ satisfies $h(z)\le(1+\eta)(D(z)+R(z))+B$. The constant may depend on $b,\eta,S,c$ but not on $z$; $b=0$ and empty sets of eligible points are included. Assuming $\mathcal B$, the conclusion is: For every $d\in\mathbb N$ and every real $\varepsilon>0$, there exists $C\in\mathbb R$, depending on $d,\varepsilon$ but not on $z$, such that every $z\in X$ with $n_z\le d$ satisfies $h(z)\le(1+\varepsilon)(D(z)+R(z))+C$. The case $d=0$ is included and has no eligible points, and $C$ has no prescribed sign.
